scientific_integrity: The result is a self-contained all-parameter cyclic-gap proof with two distinct finite verification implementations. No external independent audit or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The previously established cycle isolation number is not new. The new statements concern all minimum isolating sets, their exact number and one-vertex-replacement structure. Connected-family diameters outside residue three are not determined. Possible equivalent historical treatments under vertex-edge-domination terminology remain an originality risk. The proof is valid for every \(n\ge5\); the programs are finite checks only.
title: A four-periodic reconfiguration theorem for minimum isolating sets on cycles
